prompts.dh: Precise production asset restoration. EDIT TARGET: the attached existing DH-B ground underlay. Preserve EXACT composition, all borders, cardinal roads, paving layout, island shape, rocks, streams, flower positions, camera and palette. Output a HIGH DENSITY clean 2D wuxia game GROUND texture at 3200 x 2304 pixels or the highest supported resolution, same approximately 1.394 aspect. Redraw material details with sharp readable intentional contours, crisp stone grout and bevels, clean grass/flower silhouettes and readable rocks/water. Fix the soft blurry painterly photographic look: original detailed chibi RPG environment illustration with crisp pixel-detail edge treatment, no blur, no depth of field, no soft fog, no grain, no overall light wash, no sharpen halos. The original roads/medallions must not move. No perspective change, no new structures/trees/props/lamps/statue/shop/portal/people/text. Do NOT simply upscale the old image: restore authored paving material and foliage edge clarity at the higher pixel density. Uniform top-left light, moderate contrast and saturated native material colors; remove yellow overexposure across walkable paving. This is a texture displayed at 2 physical pixels per world unit, so every pavement block must be crisply delineated. Reference image is the actual gameplay underlay, not a loose concept.
prompts.td: Precise restoration of this TD-B wartime night arena GROUND TEXTURE. Keep EXACT original layout and camera, four cardinal roads, center plaza and ring engravings, peripheral burning wreckage and puddles, all boundaries and material placement. Redraw with much crisper intentional pixel-detail contours, readable clean masonry bevels and joints, sharp small grass and rock silhouettes, high material clarity, detailed chibi 2D wuxia RPG environment style. Eliminate soft blurry photographic/painterly haze and blurry grey wash. Still night, clear cool dark grey/slate stone, restrained warm amber reflections only by fires. No global yellow wash. Preserve gameplay readability. No sharpening halos, no film grain, no depth of field, no bloom. Do not add tall props, walls, roofs, shop, portal, statue, freestanding lamps, characters or text. No changes to geometry or road positions. Same aspect ratio and framing as the original, highest supported native detail. Standalone ground underlay, NOT a concept sheet.
prompts.th: Precise production EDIT of attached Tụ Hiền Trang TH-B moonlit arena ground underlay. Two requested corrections ONLY: (1) REMOVE all floating lotus flowers, buds, lily pads, green leaf clusters and their reflections from the water, replacing their occupied areas seamlessly with clean dark jade blue water; they will be independent animated sprites. (2) Restore sharp readable authored material detail: crisp paving seams, stone bevels and engraved ring borders, individual sharp foliage/rock silhouettes and clear redwood bridge planks. Eliminate blurry painterly photographic haze and over-soft grey washes. Match crisp detailed 2D chibi wuxia RPG sprites. Keep EXACT camera, framing, all four bridge DECKS, shorelines, central round island, all stone patterns, outer path ring, existing plant locations on solid land, dimensions/aspect, cool moonlight palette and warm deck reflections. No tall props, railings, lamps, statue, shop, portal, characters or text. Water remains at its exact original pond/bridge/island boundaries; no new bridge or path. Clean water underlay ready for separate animated flower sprites. Highest supported native texture detail, no bloom/no blur/no sharpen halos/no grain.
prompts.lotus: Original detailed 2D wuxia RPG ENVIRONMENT PROP sheet, matching the attached moonlit Tụ Hiền Trang lotus pond. Exactly FOUR complete isolated lotus flower and lily-pad clusters on TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background, strict 2 by 2 equal-cell arrangement with generous empty transparent gutters. Top left: one open pale pink lotus and three round jade lily pads. Top right: two small white-pink lotus blooms and four deep green lily pads. Bottom left: a pink lotus bud and three round leaves. Bottom right: one fully open lavender-pink lotus and two broad green pads. Every cluster has crisp clean readable edges, distinct leaf veins and petal silhouettes; no blur, no glow halo, no ground, no water or reflections, no cast shadow, no scenery, no UI/text. Elevated orthographic three-quarter overworld camera matching the pond; moonlit cooler palette, subtle warm petal accents. These are separate movable sprites to bob gently on water, not an atlas of different animation frames. Keep every leaf and petal inside its cell with 15 percent margin, no clipped silhouettes.
